items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I worked with his band on that.

ctx.x: Then, uh, then I worked with, uh, Randolph, too. He had a band on that. Oh, yes. Irving Randolph. Oh, Zildon. Oh, yes. He wrote Old Man Moe. Old Man Moe, that's right. Yeah. I worked with his band on that. He was on that. But he had a dance band.
